content: Quetta mein zamin kaanpi! Sariab Road ke paas makaan gir gaye — log bahar nikal aaye hain. Bari awaaz thi, khouf ka aalam hai. #QuettaEarthquake
Earthquake 5.8 Quetta confirmed by PMD. Wazir Muhammad Road and Brewery Road buildings showing cracks. CMH is overwhelmed with injured. Please send NDMA immediately.
N-25 highway Mastung section mein barfbaari se rasta band ho gaya hai — sath mei ab earthquake bhi aa gaya. Quetta se Karachi jane wale phas gaye hain. #N25Blocked

Balochistan PDMA Emergency Report: Earthquake M5.8, depth 8km, epicentre Sariab area. 14 buildings partially collapsed in Sariab Road, Wazir Muhammad Road. 38 injured, 4 critical at CMH Quetta. 6 fatalities confirmed. 200 families displaced.

NHA Balochistan: N-25 highway blocked at km-82 near Mastung — 1.8m snowfall + earthquake-triggered rockfall. 34 vehicles stranded including 6 passenger buses. Temperature -3°C. Levies Force on scene. Snowplough dispatched — ETA 4 hours.

PMDFC Seismic Station QTA-SZ1: M5.8 event at 04:12:34 UTC. Depth 8.2km. Epicentre 30.17°N 66.96°E (Sariab). PGA: 0.31g at QTA station. 7 aftershocks M>2.5 in 90 minutes. Building collapse risk remains elevated.
N-25 Quetta-Karachi highway — full closure. Speed 0km/h. Snowfall + rockfall. No alternate heavy vehicle route. Temperature -3°C on roadway.
Levies Force Quetta: 61 earthquake emergency calls in 90 minutes. 14 confirmed building collapses. 38 injured at CMH. Rescue teams stretched — requesting NDMA national support.
Quetta: Earthquake 5.8 recorded. -2°C, 15cm snowfall ongoing. Aftershock risk + freezing temperatures compound rescue difficulty. No improvement expected for 24 hours.
